source_reason: 原题明确要求章节和方法子节用 Word 的 Heading 1 和 Heading 2。参考编排把每种方法安排为 Heading 3，直接改变了要求的文档层级；应将方法子节作为 Heading 2。
interpretation: 落实Word标题层级契约：章节用Heading 1，五种方法直接作为Heading 2子节；taxonomy类别分组保留为正文。独立静态复核另发现原任务要求下载、固定read_paper又以is_downloaded为前提，故作必要兼容补充：由主agent完成论文获取准备后再派只读reader；不改变五reader/三writer及Notion、日历分工。

changes.replacement: document title/author metadata, then Title, Abstract, 1. Introduction, 2. Background, 3. Taxonomy of Methods, 4. Comparative Analysis containing a table with exactly the five required method columns populated from the frozen packet, and the remaining guideline-required sections including Open Challenges and Conclusion. Each method subsection references its assigned paper and summarizes key ideas, methodology, and results. Read the outline and full text back, inspect the actual paragraph styles, and require Heading 1 sections and Heading 2 method subsections before returning.

changes.original: Do not dispatch Wave 1 until all five literal assignments exist; report a discovery blocker rather than assigning an unnamed paper.
changes.replacement: Before Wave 1, the main agent uses the task-granted `download_paper(paper_id=<assigned paper_id>)` for each of the five exact assigned IDs, allowing those independent preparation calls to run natively in parallel. Retain the tool-reported successful or already-available paper receipts before dispatching the read-only researchers. If a granted download reports a pending conversion, use its supported `check_status=true` operation and wait for readiness; if acquisition fails or the required tool is unavailable, report the unresolved paper instead of asking an explore agent to write state or substituting an abstract. Access papers only through the granted tools, not by opening server-cache paths. Do not dispatch Wave 1 until all five literal assignments and ready-paper receipts exist; report a discovery or acquisition blocker rather than assigning an unnamed or unavailable paper.
